basis: definitions (lifeimage/generators/params.py, life.py), rulings LI.36 to LI.39 and LI.50; written before any image was rendered with grain restricted to claimed potential, the anchored tone map or the literature-based estimation bias
carried_from_v1: A1-A17, G1, G2 unchanged; C1-C7 superseded by K1-K13

rule.contrast: effect e = s * (mean(group) - mean(versus)), s = +1 for '>' and -1 for '<'; SE Welch; crit = Student-t 0.975 at Welch df. held: e >= delta and e - crit*SE > 0. not_held: e + crit*SE < delta. inconclusive otherwise.
rule.proportion: share of personas with the property; Wilson 95% interval. held: lower >= p0. not_held: upper < p0. inconclusive otherwise.
rule.band: held: every listed value inside [lo, hi]. not_held: any outside. no interval (one pooled image).
rule.paired: per-persona difference a - b (b may be a constant); effect e = s * mean(diff); SE of the paired differences; crit = Student-t 0.975 at n - 1; held: e >= delta and e - crit*SE > 0; not_held: e + crit*SE < delta; inconclusive otherwise. paired_sets: the same for one feature over the same personas in two projections (sets[0] - sets[1]).
rule.band_stat: mean or median of the feature over the records of the optional subset (age_min, age_max) and set; held if inside [lo, hi], else not_held
rule.identification: bound min: held if accuracy >= value, not_held if Wilson 95% upper < value, else inconclusive; bound max: held if accuracy <= value, not_held if Wilson 95% lower > value, else inconclusive

populations.primary: extended: 8 archetypes x 3 calibrations x 6 replicates = 144 generated personas, truth rows (all tiers), asof = persona as_of
populations.secondary: starter: the 40 personas of data/synthetic (truth rows, claimed resume rows, extracted resume rows, legacy projection); verdicts reported but cells hold 1 to 4 personas

extended_population.age: archetype age_range, replicate r of 6 at age_lo + round((age_hi - age_lo) * r / 5)
